descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
MAJOR  UPDATE OCTOBER 2026 (10GB of new content) 
Try before you buy.

TL;DR A Theme Park currently being Imagineered but already with 2 highly detailed long format dark rides, with optional, but satisfying games. Hours of fun! 

This app is all about the experience of exploring a Theme Park, discovering its interactive elements and of course getting on highly detailed dark rides solo, or with friends & family. The Park is still being Imagineered, but there are already hours of content to be enjoyed and discovered. Plus you can look forward to free updates as I grow the park so come back every year or so.

The flagship attractions presently are Act 1 of 'Into the Metaverse,' a 14.5 minute dark ride showcasing humanity’s quest throughout history for ever deeper immersion and a sneak peek of the 26 minute, 75% complete 'The Haunted Castle', the biggest dark ride ever created. 

These are high effort, extremely polished rides with narration, music, hundreds of audio animatronics, massive sets and all the trimmings you would expect at a real Theme Park. A lot of effort has gone into the app to make it a seamless experience without any loading screens or other immersion breaking limitations. This app is not a game, but there are some game elements to be unlocked for those interested but they are not a requirement.

If you miss being in a Theme Park, then this is the app for you. 

See you in the park soon,
Immersive Matthew
Imagineer

Discord Server
https://discord.gg/hdx8TP29Aw
